$schema: Buildable structures (spec §9). era gates availability against the civ's researched era (see tech.json / TechSystem). cost is {resourceId: amount}. buildTicks = construction time citizens spend hauling/building, scaled loosely by footprint/size. sprite is the SpriteAtlas key. 'provides' is a data-driven effect bag read by systems (no hardcoded logic per building): housing, storage, waterPerDay, foodPerDay, spoilageReduction, knowledgePerDay, moralePerDay, vision, tradeBonus, defense, victoryMonument, isTownCenter.

buildings.name: Camp
buildings.desc: Your first foothold. Drop it near wood, water and food.

buildings.name: House
buildings.desc: Shelters citizens. More housing raises your population cap.

buildings.name: Well
buildings.desc: A steady water supply so you stop depending on ponds.

buildings.name: Road
buildings.desc: Paves the settlement. Purely organisational — lays out your capital.

buildings.name: Farm
buildings.desc: Grows food each day. Yields drop in winter (spec §8).

buildings.name: Granary
buildings.desc: Expands storage and slows food spoilage before winter.

buildings.name: Market
buildings.desc: A trading hub — improves the value of diplomatic trades.

buildings.name: Watchtower
buildings.desc: Reveals the fog around it — see rivals and threats coming.

buildings.name: Library
buildings.desc: Generates Knowledge each day — the engine of your research.

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.desc: Trains and quarters defenders — assign a citizen the Soldier role to have them guard and fight.

buildings.name: Blacksmith
buildings.desc: Unlocks the tool shop — buy axes, pickaxes and swords for your civilization.

buildings.name: Wall
buildings.desc: Fortifies your capital. Lay several to ring your settlement.

buildings.name: Temple
buildings.desc: Lifts morale across the whole civilization each day.

buildings.name: Grand Monument
buildings.desc: The ultimate work. Completing it wins a Legacy Victory (spec §16).
